label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter() flows directly to the response body without HTML encoding. The ternary condition '(7 * 42) - num > 200' evaluates to false (188 > 200), ensuring the variable 'bar' retains the raw user input. This value is written to the response via response.getWriter(), constituting a Reflected XSS vulnerability. The X-XSS-Protection header is disabled.

evidence.note: User input passed to doSomething() method.
Conditional assignment ensures 'bar' equals 'param' (condition 188>200 is false), preserving unsanitized input.
Unsanitized 'bar' written directly to response body via response.getWriter().
